study: HiddenBench Qwen3-14B full-information capability screen, reasoning mode
motivation: v0.2/v0.3 used reasoning off and temperature-zero greedy decoding. The Qwen3-14B model card recommends thinking mode for complex reasoning, temperature 0.6, top-k 20, top-p 0.95, and advises against greedy decoding in thinking mode. This follow-up tests the model's documented reasoning configuration before concluding the task/model is outside the local operating region.

model.name: Qwen3-14B-Q4_K_M
model.runtime: llama.cpp b11202; RTX 4060 Laptop GPU 8 GB; 24 GPU layers with CPU offload; one slot; 8192 context

design.evaluation: Mean accuracy of the three sets of four independent initial votes against task gold answers, using the official HiddenBench prompt, answer labels, and JSON vote schema.

decision_rule: If full-profile initial vote accuracy remains below 0.8, no communication-protocol ranking will be conducted on this checkpoint/task pair. If it reaches 0.8, a separately preregistered full episode study is needed before any protocol comparison.
limits: Twelve stochastic votes over three related public tasks, despite fixed seeds.
This compares one documented inference configuration with prior greedy runs; it does not isolate reasoning mode from sampling settings or establish model scaling.
No discussion, hidden-profile run, or protocol comparison is included.
